evidence: Peptide sequences were searched against the C. auris subset of the UniProt database
Both C. auris total protein and CWAP extracts were analysed
Five C. auris isolates belonging to the clade III from bloodstream infections were used in this study
Candidozyma auris (Candida auris) is an emerging pathogenic yeast of global concern
two-dimensional electrophoresis followed by Western blotting (2D-WB) was performed using only the CWAP extract
